title: Main window chat transcript, streaming display, input field
description: Implement the chat UI: scrollable message list (user/assistant/system lines), real-time SSE token streaming (append as tokens arrive), tool call/result rendering (name + args), code block display with syntax highlighting, multi-line input field (Cmd+Enter to send), auto-scroll to bottom. Async: goroutines for SSE reading, UI updates via channels.
acceptance_criteria: Chat transcript displays user and assistant messages
SSE streaming: tokens appear in real-time as they arrive
Tool calls rendered with name and pretty-printed args
Code blocks displayed with syntax highlighting
Multi-line input: Cmd+Enter sends, Enter adds newline
Auto-scroll: transcript scrolls to bottom on new content
No UI freezes: SSE reading in goroutine, UI updates via channel
